definitions.explanation: A large natural stream of water flowing to the sea.
A smaller body of flowing water.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}で{魚|さかな}を{釣|つ}った。
examples.english: I caught fish in the river.

examples.japanese: この{川|かわ}は{深|ふか}いので{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: This river is deep, so please be careful.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{水|みず}が{きれい|きれい}だ。
{山|やま}から{川|かわ}が{流|なが}れている。
examples.english: A stream flows from the mountain.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さな{川|かわ}で{遊|あそ}んだ。
examples.english: I played in a small stream.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}に{沿|そ}って{歩|ある}いた。
{森|もり}の{中|なか}に{川|かわ}があった。
examples.english: There was a stream in the forest.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of the stream.

notes:
{川|かわ} means river or stream - a natural body of flowing water.

READINGS IN COMPOUNDS:
- かわ: standalone or beginning of compound ({川|かわ}{魚|ざかな})
- がわ: often at end of place names ({隅田川|すみだがわ})

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {川|かわ}で{泳|およ}ぐ: to swim in a river
- {川|かわ}を{渡|わた}る: to cross a river
- {川|かわ}が{流|なが}れる: a river flows
- {川|かわ}に{沿|そ}って: along the river

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {川岸|かわぎし}: riverbank
- {川上|かわかみ}: upstream
- {川下|かわしも}: downstream
- {小川|おがわ}: stream, brook
- {河川|かせん}: rivers (formal/official term)

FAMOUS JAPANESE RIVERS:
- {信濃川|しなのがわ}: Shinano River (longest in Japan)
- {利根川|とねがわ}: Tone River
- {隅田川|すみだがわ}: Sumida River (Tokyo)
- {淀川|よどがわ}: Yodo River (Osaka)

RELATED WORDS:
- {河|かわ}: river (alternative kanji, used in formal/literary contexts)
- {海|うみ}: sea
- {湖|みずうみ}: lake
